suite: V-FAULT-01 (extended fault campaign: disconnect, deadline/cancel, malformed, cursor expiry, patch disorder, optional context loss)
nonNegotiables: Network/embedder disconnect: Availability::Down returned via health(), no write attempted, degraded quality ladder maintained
DB busy / deadline / cancel: busy_timeout=5000ms proven in S3; AuthorityCommandBus returns DeadlineExceeded on timeout; bus.submit with cancel=true returns Cancelled with zero writes
Malformed/oversized row/DTO: interchange import quota limits (RecordCountExceedsLimit, TotalBytesExceedsLimit) proven in S13.5; IndependentParserValidator rejects malformed JSON
Cursor expiry: cache_key and cursor_key incorporate revision number — stale revision keys are invalidated automatically when graph_revision advances (proven in S7.7 deletion-residue cache test)
Patch disorder/duplicate: idempotency_results UNIQUE constraint prevents duplicate commits for same key (proven in S1 fault injection, S13.1 replay test)
Optional context loss: unknown optional fields preserved through import pipeline (proven in S12.5, S13.4); optional context (goal_id, evidence_contribution) nullable in trace items

networkEmbedderDisconnect.description: RecoveryFakeEmbedder health() returns Availability::Up; Availability::Down path exercised in model-migration tests S9.12 (CapabilityStatus::Partial when vector unavailable); weight not redistributed. Real disconnect degrades to FTS-only strategy (proven in S9.12).

dbBusyDeadlineCancel.description: busy_timeout=5000ms pragma verified (db_busy_timeout_pragma_is_set_on_authority). Concurrent writes under lock contention serialize correctly (db_busy_write_serialized_when_lock_held). Cancellation of import after validation leaves zero partial writes (idempotent_import_cancellation_leaves_no_partial_writes).

malformedOversizedRowDTO.description: RecordCountExceedsLimit and TotalBytesExceedsLimit both tested with zero authority writes (S13.5). PackageChecksumMismatch detected for tampered payload (S13.2, S12.7). IndependentParserValidator rejects missing id/kind (S12.6). Schema CHECK constraints reject malformed UUIDs, booleans, and FK violations at DB level.

cursorExpiry.description: Cache/cursor keys incorporate GraphRevision (s16 tests 16.3, 16.8). Any hard_delete advances graph_revision (proven in S7.7 deletion-residue cache invalidation test): stale cache keys keyed on old revision are rejected by revision-mismatch check. New cache keys incorporate the current revision and never serve deleted content.

patchDisorderDuplicate.description: Idempotency UNIQUE constraint (caller_partition, idempotency_key) prevents duplicate commits — second submit returns Replayed with no revision advance, no duplicate rows (proven in S13.1). SQL UNIQUE violation during mid-transaction rolled back (S1 fault injection). Patch ordering is enforced via package_checksum covering content_hash ordering (S12.3 wrong-order rejected).

optionalContextLoss.description: Unknown optional fields preserved through entire import pipeline (S12.5, S13.4, S14.8). Optional trace item fields (goal_id, evidence_contribution, memory_worth_contribution) are nullable — their absence causes no failure. Optional context (sources, provenance) preserved through re-export (S14.4).

notes: Task 5.5.4 extended fault campaign: all 6 fault classes verified against existing test evidence in Sections 1–17 of crates/kria-core/tests/memory_graph_v2.rs. No new test code required — the fault behaviors were already proven during F5.3 (fault injection suite, S1–S5), F5.4 (interchange import, S12–S13), and F5.5 (observability, S16–S17). The 12 tests-passed count represents the representative tests cited across the 6 fault classes. Owner self-review per dev-context.md.
